# OpenMesh for Node.js

> OpenMesh (openmesh-node) is an open-source TypeScript-first Node.js service runtime. Start with native HTTP APIs and grow into an application-native service mesh with discovery, traffic policy, bounded backpressure, retries, circuit breaking, workload identity, mTLS and OpenTelemetry-compatible metrics.

Current release: 0.5.0
Runtime: Node.js >= 22
License: MIT
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/openmesh-node
Source: https://github.com/yaohuangguan/openmesh-node

## Canonical pages

- Homepage: https://openmesh-node.vercel.app/

## Key package entry points

- openmesh-node: HTTP application runtime and application mesh facade
- openmesh-node/plugins: request/body/health and ecosystem plugins
- openmesh-node/http: advanced immutable HTTP contracts
- openmesh-node/db: lifecycle wrapper for existing database/ORM clients
- openmesh-node/mesh: lower-level peer routing and distributed HTTP
- openmesh-node/services: registration, discovery and live configuration
- openmesh-node/services/redis: durable Redis adapters
- openmesh-node/otel: OpenTelemetry-compatible metrics bridge

## Important boundaries

OpenMesh does not provide Kubernetes networking, transparent traffic interception, certificate issuance, a managed control plane, or a custom database query language. It is independent of Openmesh Network and the RWTH OpenMesh geometry library.
